learning_outcomes.text: Know and understand the fundamental principles of vehicle design from a functional point of view
Know and understand the interaction between the vehicle and its environment
Understand the specific characteristics of different types of vehicles (automobiles, heavy vehicles) and their adaptability for the transport of people and goods
Know the advantages and disadvantages of using different materials in vehicles, as well as the constructive aspects involved in using one or another
Know the basic principles of primary and secondary safety in motor vehicles

syllabus_topics: Automobile dynamic behavior: Longitudinal dynamics, Lateral dynamics, Vertical dynamics
Basic regulations applied to automobiles (national and European context)
Design of automobile systems (suspension system elements and kinematic and dynamic behavior of the vehicle)
teaching_methods: Lectures with exposition of theoretical contents and application examples.
Practical classes including dynamic evaluation of small vehicles and, when possible, passenger cars.
Visit -in-person or virtual- to companies/institutions related to vehicle management and safety.

assessment_methods.method: Individual written test composed of short questions and problems
Compulsory practicals, evaluation is passed by delivering assigned tasks

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on an individual written test (85%) and academic work (15%). A minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required on the written test. Compulsory practicals must be passed by delivering assigned tasks, but do not contribute to the final numerical grade.
bibliography: Introducción a la Dinámica de Vehículos. Juan José Alba López. Ed. CopyCenter. 2025.
